prompt:
Below are 60 customer feedback lines about a smart water bottle app. For each line, classify the sentiment as positive, negative, neutral or mixed, and extract the one product feature it mentions (or 'none'). Treat every line on its own. Then write a short summary: how many lines per sentiment and the three most mentioned features, with the full per-line table placed in the answer.

1. The Tidewell app reminds me to drink water and I actually do it now, love it.
2. Syncing with my bottle takes forever, sometimes it never connects.
3. Battery on the bottle lasts about two weeks, which is fine.
4. The streak badges are a fun touch but the sound is too loud.
5. Setup was confusing, I had to scan the code four times.
6. Great customer support, they replaced my cap within two days.
7. The app crashed when I changed the daily goal.
8. Not sure why I need an account just to see my own numbers.
9. The dark theme looks great at night.
10. Bottle leaks a little around the lid after a month.
11. Reminders arrive at odd hours, even after I set quiet time.
12. Simple and clean, does what it says.
13. The weekly chart is hard to read on my small phone.
14. I like the goal suggestions based on weather.
15. Price is a bit high for what it is.
16. The bottle keeps my water cold all day, impressive.
17. Notifications stopped working after the last update.
18. Friend challenges are the reason I keep using it.
19. Why is there no way to export my history?
20. The lid is hard to open with wet hands.
21. Packaging was lovely and arrived early.
22. Pairing worked on the first try, nice surprise.
23. The app drains my phone battery overnight.
24. Honestly it is fine, nothing special.
25. The widget on my home screen is exactly what I wanted.
26. Cleaning the sensor ring is a pain.
27. Streaks reset when I travel across time zones, which is unfair.
28. The unit switch between millilitres and ounces is buried in menus.
29. Customer support never answered my email.
30. Colours of the bottle look better in real life than in the photos.
31. The app asks for a rating every single day.
32. Hydration reminders feel supportive, not naggy.
33. The sensor ring cracked after I dropped the bottle once.
34. Good value during the sale.
35. I wish there were a tablet version of the app.
36. It counts my sips accurately when I compare with a measuring cup.
37. The bottle is heavier than I expected.
38. Login failed three times before it let me in.
39. Love the little animation when I hit my goal.
40. Reminders are helpful but the wording is repetitive.
41. Shipping took three weeks, but the product itself is great.
42. The app is slow to open on my older phone.
43. Sharing my progress to chat apps works smoothly.
44. The strap is a nice addition for hiking.
45. Paired it with my watch, and the numbers disagree.
46. Delivery box was damaged but the bottle was fine.
47. Soooo happy with this, bought one for my sister too.
48. The font in the app is too small.
49. No offline mode, my hydration data vanished on the plane.
50. Support chat was friendly but could not fix the sync problem.
51. The goal bar fills correctly, simple as that.
52. Tracking works but the calendar view misses some days.
53. I cannot find the setting to change my name.
54. The mint green colour is gorgeous.
55. Update 2.3 fixed the sync problem, thank you.
56. The cap rattles when the bottle is empty.
57. The battery warning came far too late, it died mid run.
58. Does what the description promised, no complaints.
59. Needs a way to log other drinks like tea.
60. The privacy page is clear about what is stored, appreciated.
